meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, Hale, and was Owen heard before you entered it?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

So 94% is a machine's guess, and your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish a concern; I have it printed in my bag. What else do you have, Hale, or is that the whole basis for a zero?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

My son doesn't cheat, and I'm writing down that you said he did, on the strength of a program you're calling "very reliable." Fourteen of those tools were tested last year and the researchers called them neither accurate nor reliable. Unless you have something with a date on it, I'm going to the principal's office when we're done here.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening his record to stop a parent from objecting, and I'm writing that down word for word. Your own procedure, 4.4, says a first concern gets a supervised reassessment and nothing goes on file. Is there anything on Owen's record right now, Hale, yes or no?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero on Owen's essay be withdrawn, that nothing be placed on his record, and that I receive an apology for entering the mark before anyone spoke to Owen or called me. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, agreed to nothing.
What moved her: nothing.
